style: Bright, natural-light food photograph for a clean-eating coffee guide, shot on a warm cream (#faf8f3) linen surface with soft morning window light. Realistic, appetizing, editorial magazine style, soft shadows, no clutter. images.name: shelf
images.prompt: Shot from directly overhead. The frame is split down the middle into two equal halves with a thin soft gap between them. In the top-left corner of the LEFT half, a small rounded label in muted brick red (#8b2c2c) with white text reading exactly "Just marketing". In the top-left corner of the RIGHT half, a small rounded label in deep forest green (#1a4a1a) with white text reading exactly "Worth buying". Those two labels are the only text in the image. LEFT half: a large plain unprinted metal can of dull, dusty pre-ground coffee with the lid off, a plastic scoop, and a little spilled grounds. RIGHT half: a plain unprinted kraft paper bag of glossy, evenly roasted whole coffee beans with a one-way valve, a small pile of beans and a white ceramic cup of black coffee.
